description: Sensitive credentials such as passwords, credentials, or usernames were found hardcoded in source strings or Smali code.
recommendation: Do not store secrets in source code. Retrieve credentials dynamically at runtime using secure APIs or utilize the Android Keystore system to protect keys.

description: Exposed generic API keys or client identifiers were identified in resource strings or smali code.
recommendation: Restrict API keys to specific IP addresses, referrers, or Android packages via backend consoles. Avoid static placement.

description: JSON Web Token (JWT) signatures were found embedded within application resources or smali variables.
recommendation: Move authorization tokens out of application bytecode. Retrieve tokens dynamically upon user authentication.

description: Hardcoded OAuth client access or refresh tokens were discovered.
recommendation: Use OAuth flow protocols dynamically and obtain authentication tokens securely at runtime, storing them in encrypted local storage.

description: Static authorization Bearer headers or bearer tokens were detected in the application code.
recommendation: Authenticate dynamically and store Bearer tokens inside the Android Keystore rather than hardcoding.

description: Basic Authorization header parameters (base64 encoded credentials) were found statically defined in code.
recommendation: Avoid Basic Authentication headers in client-side code. Use token-based dynamic authentication.

description: AWS access key identifiers or secret tokens were identified, allowing direct AWS cloud environment queries.
recommendation: Revoke leaked AWS keys immediately. Use temporary security credentials via AWS STS or Amazon Cognito.

description: Direct Firebase database endpoints were discovered in code assets.
recommendation: Ensure Firebase database rules require authentication and enforce access controls to prevent public reads/writes.

description: Exposed Google API keys were identified, which could allow unauthorized usage of Google services on the developer's quota.
recommendation: Apply package name restrictions and API limits in the Google Cloud Console for the exposed key.

description: Usage of standard SharedPreferences indicates local key-value storage of sensitive key/value entries in plaintext XML files.
recommendation: Utilize EncryptedSharedPreferences to transparently encrypt sensitive key/value storage.

description: Creation or usage of database SQL schemes designed to record plaintext user passwords or card metrics.
recommendation: Encrypt SQLite database backups on the device using SQLCipher libraries.

description: Application writes sensitive info or reads executables from external SD Card storages, which are shared globally.
recommendation: Store private data exclusively in the internal application cache directories.

description: Unencrypted HTTP endpoints are defined inside application files, permitting transit intercept vulnerabilities.
recommendation: Replace all http:// endpoints with https:// configurations to ensure encrypted network payloads.

description: Cleartext network traffic is allowed system-wide in application configs.
recommendation: Configure Network Security Configurations and remove cleartextTrafficPermitted flags in the production manifest.

description: JavaScript execution is enabled within WebViews, which could lead to XSS exploitation.
recommendation: Do not enable setJavaScriptEnabled unless strictly required by application pages.

description: WebView addJavascriptInterface bindings expose internal Java APIs to JavaScript context, risking remote code execution in older devices.
recommendation: Perform strict WebView origin checking and target API level 17+ to limit reflections.

description: MD5 hash generation is used. MD5 is highly vulnerable to hash collision attacks.
recommendation: Migrate algorithms to SHA-256 or bcrypt for password checking and integrity verification.

description: SHA-1 cryptographical hashing is configured, which is cryptographically broken.
recommendation: Replace SHA-1 configurations with SHA-256 or SHA-3 algorithms.

description: DES cipher encryption is initialized. DES uses weak key sizes that are easily broken by modern hardware.
recommendation: Upgrade cipher structures to utilize AES with key sizes of 256 bits.

description: ECB cipher blocks encryption mode is in use. ECB leaks patterns in encrypted messages.
recommendation: Utilize cipher block modes like GCM or CBC with a randomly generated initialization vector.

description: Android activities are exported without access permissions, which could allow external intent injection.
recommendation: Remove exported tags or declare signature protection permissions in the Android Manifest.

description: Services are exported, allowing external programs to bind and invoke code functions.
recommendation: Enforce signature level permissions to limit binders to signed packages.

description: Broadcast Receivers are exported, which could allow unauthorized Intent spoofing attacks.
recommendation: Enforce permissions on Broadcast Receivers or register them dynamically in code with local flags.

description: Raw string concatenations are passed directly to rawQuery/execSQL sqlite queries.
recommendation: Utilize parameterized query templates (selectionArgs) to enforce input validation.

description: Exposing local private filesystem files to external apps using insecure file:// scheme intents.
recommendation: Transition to dynamic FileProvider content:// schemes.

description: debuggable=true config permits connecting debuggers at runtime to read app memory.
recommendation: Ensure android:debuggable is false in production manifest profiles.

description: System printing mechanisms write private logs containing credential keywords.
recommendation: Remove debug logging routines from release builds using Proguard templates.

description: Static secret keys or decryption passwords are kept as code variables.
recommendation: Avoid using symmetric static key variables in APK storage models.
